title: Your phone is the controller
text: Drag on the left pad to drive. On the right pad, drag to turn your turret and tap to fire.

scene.phone: Drag to aim · tap to fire
scene.label: right thumb

title: Bank your shots
text: Shells bounce off walls once. Line up trick shots around corners. Your own shells can't hurt you.

title: Mines and crates
text: Drop up to two mines from your phone. Explosions smash wooden crates and anything parked next to them.

title: Grab pick-ups
text: Boxes appear around the arena: rockets, spread shots, a ricochet laser, homing missiles, shields, turbo, cloaks and more.

title: Four ways to play
text: Last Tank Standing, Frag Frenzy, Hold the Hill or Bank Shots Only. Add computer tanks and switch pick-ups on or off before you start.

title: Six wild arenas
text: Slide on ice, dodge lava, ride teleporters, fight in the dark and hide in the bushes. Last tank rolling wins!
